    Profile

    Füry is a young girl who is known as the Veda Templar's "Number Five." She is a member of one of the leading occultist families in Wadatsumi, and had a bright and promising future until she was forced to flee after the invasion. She despaired of a world with no justice, and when she gave into these feelings of despair, she gained immense power and her occult arts became more effective.

    Origin: Lost Blue
    Gender: Female
    Height: 155cm
    Weight: 42kg
    Birthday: Oct 24
    Blood Type: Type Kn
    Zodiac: Moon of the Fiery Imperial Skies
    Likes: Peace and quiet
    Hobbies: Fortunetelling and meditation
    Illust: 渡り棒
    CV: 芳野由奈
